action.sql: SELECT s.date, sum(CASE WHEN d.router_model_id IN ('RMO-001','RMO-002') AND s.firmware_version='nový' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_fw_001_002, sum(CASE WHEN NOT (d.router_model_id IN ('RMO-001','RMO-002') AND s.firmware_version='nový') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other, avg(s.wait_minutes) AS w FROM support_call s JOIN device d ON d.id=s.device_id WHERE s.date BETWEEN '2025-02-28' AND '2025-03-22' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
